description: This file contains a Bash script function 'platform_do_upgrade_failsafe_datachk' used for handling failsafe data check during platform upgrade process on OpenWrt embedded devices. It manages image verification, checksum calculations, environment configuration, and flashing procedures for U-Boot bootloader-based systems.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_failsafe_datachk
methods.description: Main function that performs image size validation, checksum verification, environment setup, and flashing of the kernel and root filesystem for devices using U-Boot with a failsafe mechanism.
